name: Spell Reflection
description: Trigger: The creature succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, or a spell’s attack roll misses it. Response—Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the creature can see within 120 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Force damage.
